system.description:
HUMAN

Humans are renowned for their adaptability and quick thinking.

Prerequisites Inner Discipline

When you use a conviction point to reroll a Mental Focus skill check, you only expend it if the result of the check is a success or better.

Automated: when a conviction point buys Advantage on a Mental Focus check and the result is a Success or better, the point is given back and does not count as this round's spend; the card says so. The core's conviction has no reroll, so this reads it as conviction's Advantage (Graham's ruling B5-3). A DC set after the roll is read when it arrives.
